biggest_catch: The friend's account must stay open at least 90 calendar days with a positive balance on the 90th day - anything shorter and you get nothing.
catches: Referrer: existing CSB consumer client referring a new client to open a consumer checking account (subject to approval).
Referrer earns a $50 Refer-A-Friend bonus per referral; 'Existing clients can earn unlimited Refer-A-Friend bonuses.'

Friend must: open a consumer checking account; keep it open a minimum of 90 calendar days; have no previously closed CSB consumer checking within the past 12 months; have a balance greater than zero at end of business on the 90th calendar day.
Bonus credited to the account within 30 calendar days after the 90-day qualifying period, provided both accounts are open at payment.
Cannot be combined with other offers; must be an Iowa resident to open an account.
Ongoing referral offer, subject to change without notice; bonuses reported to the IRS.
Minimum $100 opening deposit for qualifying consumer checking accounts (BankOn $25); $30 early-closing fee if closed within 90 days.
